findings.reason: the builder must either bound the pre-check hold or skip a predecessor held only on session allowance, which changes §18's deliverable and its case-2 done-when.
findings.text: §18's admission pre-check holds a later-ranked overlapping request "with no failure recorded" whenever an earlier-ranked overlapping queued request exists, but that predecessor can itself be held indefinitely by a session allowance of 0, a state the plan's own §4 evidence records (line 250: a session "never listed at its turn can wait forever"); the later request then has no failure, no back-off and no rank escape, so the mechanism starves a launchable request — the inversion §18 exists to prevent
